[[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma's]] '''father''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chandrilan/Legends|Chandrilan]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as an [[Arbiter-general/Legends|arbiter-general]], settling disputes between opposing [[Species/Legends|species]], [[City/Legends|cities]], and [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. By observing him, his daughter learned the arts of diplomacy. He was [[Marriage/Legends|married]]<ref name="SWS" /> to [[Tanis Mothma]],<ref name="CCW" /> who was [[Governor/Legends|governor]]<ref name="SWS" /> of [[Hanna City/Legends|Hanna City]].<ref name="CCW" />
